_how: Relaunch: Workflow({scriptPath: 'prototypes/build/wf/legal-recon.js' (absolute path), args: {markets: <one batch below>}}). Run the 4 batches as 4 parallel workflows. Web search budget is shared per turn (~200 searches): if researchers report the budget is exhausted, continue in a later turn.

batches.name: the European Union (EU-level baseline)
batches.scope: This brief is the EU-LEVEL baseline used by all EU country briefs: Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83 (as amended by the Omnibus Directive 2019/2161), Digital Content and Services Directive 2019/770, Unfair Contract Terms Directive 93/13, Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, Rome I art 6, Brussels I bis arts 17-19, GDPR (incl. art 3(2), art 27 representative, arts 13/14/22, Chapter V transfers incl. adequacy of Saudi Arabia: none), ePrivacy cookies, EU AI Act (scope for a job-seeker-side tool; Annex III point 4; art 50 transparency; application dates), DSA if relevant, VAT OSS for non-EU digital service sellers, the ODR platform repeal (July 2025), the 2023 Directive on financial services at a distance (withdrawal button, art 11a CRD from 19 June 2026), and any EU rules on cancellation of subscriptions.

batches.name: Germany
batches.scope: Cover BGB 312 ff (312j button solution, 312k Kündigungsbutton), 355-356 withdrawal and its expiry for services/digital content, 309 Nr. 9 (Fair Consumer Contracts Act: terms, tacit renewal, notice), AGB control 305-310, Impressum (DDG), price indication ordinance, UWG, BDSG, German-language expectations. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points but check German transposition specifics.

batches.name: France
batches.scope: Cover Code de la consommation: L221-18 ff withdrawal and L221-28 exceptions, L215-1 loi Chatel renewal information, L215-1-1 résiliation en trois clics (2023), L212-1 and R212-1/2 unfair terms lists, loi Toubon (French language), mentions légales (LCEN art 6), médiation de la consommation (mandatory consumer mediator), DGCCRF enforcement, CNIL, price display. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: the Netherlands
batches.scope: Cover BW Book 6 and 7 (6:230g ff distance contracts, 6:236/237 black/grey lists incl. tacit renewal rules art 6:236 j), ACM guidance on subscriptions and cancellation, AP (GDPR), language. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: Belgium
batches.scope: Cover Code de droit économique / Wetboek van economisch recht Book VI (VI.45 ff distance contracts, VI.83/VI.84 abusive clauses), tacit renewal rules, language laws (FR/NL), APD/GBA (GDPR), mandatory info. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: Ireland
batches.scope: Cover the Consumer Rights Act 2022 (Parts 2-4 digital content/services, unfair terms Schedule 3), European Union (Consumer Information, Cancellation and Other Rights) Regulations 2013 as amended, CCPC enforcement, Data Protection Act 2018 / DPC, language. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: Spain
batches.scope: Cover TRLGDCU (RDL 1/2007) arts 97-108 distance contracts and withdrawal, arts 82-91 abusive clauses, subscription/renewal rules incl. 2022-2024 reforms (Ley 4/2022, servicios de atención a la clientela law 2025 if in force), LSSI information duties, Spanish language requirements, AEPD. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: the United States
batches.scope: Cover federal (ROSCA, FTC Act s5, the status of the FTC Negative Option / click-to-cancel rule after the 8th Circuit vacatur in July 2025 and any 2026 re-proposal, EFTA/Reg E for debit, FAA arbitration and class waivers, AAA/JAMS consumer rules and mass-arbitration fee exposure) and the key state auto-renewal laws (California ARL as amended by AB 2863 effective July 1 2025, New York GBL 527-a, Illinois, Colorado, Virginia, Minnesota 2025, plus a general multi-state compliance floor), state consumer privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA thresholds and whether Uptal likely meets them; Colorado, Virginia, Texas etc.), state AI-in-hiring rules relevant to a job-seeker-side tool (NYC LL144 applies to employers, Illinois AI Video Interview Act, Colorado AI Act timing), sales tax on SaaS for remote sellers (economic nexus), and the enforceability of a KSA choice-of-law/forum clause against US consumers.

batches.name: Canada
batches.scope: Cover federal (PIPEDA, Competition Act drip pricing 2022-2024 amendments, CASL for emails) and provinces: Quebec (Consumer Protection Act distance contracts ss. 54.1-54.16, s.11.2/11.3 unilateral changes, Bill 96 Charter of the French language for contracts of adhesion and websites, Law 25 privacy incl. privacy officer and PIA for transfers outside Quebec), Ontario (Consumer Protection Act 2023 when in force, internet agreements), BC (Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act), Alberta; arbitration/class waivers (Uber v Heller, Quebec CPA s.11.1 bans), GST/HST/QST registration for non-resident digital sellers.

batches.name: the United Kingdom
batches.scope: Cover Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 (14-day cancellation for services and digital content, express request + acknowledgement), Consumer Rights Act 2015 (Part 1 digital content/services remedies, Part 2 unfair terms, Schedule 2 grey list), the DMCC Act 2024 Part 4 Chapter 2 subscription contract regime (reminder notices, cooling-off, easy exit) and its CURRENT commencement status in 2026 (pack research says delayed to spring 2027), DMCC enforcement by the CMA with direct fines, UK GDPR + DPA 2018 + Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, UK representative under art 27, VAT on digital services for overseas sellers, forum against consumers.

batches.name: Australia
batches.scope: Cover the Australian Consumer Law (consumer guarantees for services ss.60-62 and remedies, s.64 no contracting out, false or misleading 'no refunds' representations s.29(1)(m), unfair contract terms regime with penalties since Nov 2023), ACCC guidance on subscription traps and the 2025-2026 proposals on unfair trading practices / subscription cancellation, Privacy Act 1988 and the 2024 amendments (statutory tort, automated decision transparency from Dec 2026), small-business exemption thresholds, GST for offshore digital sellers, jurisdiction against consumers.

batches.name: Switzerland
batches.scope: Cover Swiss law: no general statutory withdrawal right for online contracts, UCA art 8 unfair terms, tacit renewal case law, revised Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) incl. art 14 representative for foreign controllers and Saudi Arabia transfer status, Swiss VAT for foreign digital service providers (CHF 100k worldwide threshold), languages (DE/FR/IT), Lugano Convention consumer forum.

batches.name: Italy
batches.scope: Cover Codice del Consumo arts 45-67 distance contracts and withdrawal, arts 33-38 vessatorie clauses incl. art 1341-1342 c.c. double signature for onerous clauses, AGCM enforcement and subscription cases, Garante privacy, Italian language. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: Poland
batches.scope: Cover the Consumer Rights Act 2014 (as amended 2023 for digital content/services), abusive clauses register (art 385(1) KC), UOKiK enforcement on subscriptions, UODO, Polish language act requirements for consumer contracts. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: Sweden
batches.scope: Cover the Distance and Off-Premises Contracts Act (2005:59) withdrawal, Consumer Contract Terms Act (1994:1512), Konsumentverket guidance on subscriptions and cancellation, IMY (GDPR), Swedish language expectations, ARN consumer complaints board. Use the EU baseline for directive-level points.

batches.name: the United Arab Emirates
batches.scope: Cover Federal Law 15/2020 on Consumer Protection and its executive regulation (Cabinet Resolution 66/2023) incl. e-commerce consumer rights, Federal Decree-Law 14/2023 on Modern Technology Trade (e-commerce), Federal Decree-Law 45/2021 PDPL and its status, DIFC/ADGM where relevant, UAE VAT for non-resident digital suppliers, Arabic language rules, enforceability of KSA law/forum against UAE consumers, payment refund rules of the Central Bank.

batches.name: Qatar
batches.scope: Cover Law 8/2008 Consumer Protection and its executive regulation, e-commerce law (Decree-Law 16/2010), Law 13/2016 PDPPL, Arabic language, payments, enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Kuwait
batches.scope: Cover Law 39/2014 Consumer Protection, Law 20/2014 Electronic Transactions, CITRA Data Privacy Protection Regulation (2021/2024), Arabic language, payments (KNET), enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Bahrain
batches.scope: Cover Law 35/2012 Consumer Protection, Electronic Communications and Transactions Law (Decree-Law 54/2018), PDPL Law 30/2018, VAT 10% for non-resident digital suppliers, Arabic language, payments (BENEFIT), enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Oman
batches.scope: Cover Royal Decree 66/2014 Consumer Protection Law and executive regulations, Electronic Transactions Law (RD 69/2008), PDPL (RD 6/2022) and executive regulation 2024, VAT 5% for non-resident digital suppliers, Arabic language, enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Egypt
batches.scope: Cover Consumer Protection Law 181/2018 (incl. distance selling and the return/withdrawal right and its application to services), its executive regulations, Personal Data Protection Law 151/2020 and executive regulations (licensing with the PDPC), VAT on non-resident digital services (2023 regime), Arabic language, CBE payment rules, enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Morocco
batches.scope: Cover Law 31-08 on consumer protection (art 36 7-day withdrawal for distance contracts and its exceptions, abusive clauses arts 15-20), Law 53-05 electronic exchange, Law 09-08 data protection and CNDP declaration/authorization incl. cross-border transfer authorization, VAT on foreign digital services (2024 Finance Law; in force 11 June 2026 per pack research), French/Arabic language, enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Tunisia
batches.scope: Cover Law 2000-83 on electronic exchanges and commerce (art 30 10-day withdrawal), Law 92-117 consumer protection, Organic Law 2004-63 data protection and INPDP authorization incl. transfers, the draft data law status, foreign exchange constraints on paying a foreign merchant, French/Arabic, enforceability.

batches.name: Algeria
batches.scope: Cover Law 18-05 on e-commerce (incl. registration requirements for e-sellers and withdrawal/return rules), Law 09-03 consumer protection, Law 18-07 personal data protection and ANPDP incl. transfer authorization, foreign exchange constraints on cross-border card payments, Arabic/French language, enforceability.

batches.name: Libya
batches.scope: Cover Law 23/2010 on commercial activity, the consumer protection law (verify current law), Electronic Transactions Law 6/2022, absence or status of a data protection law, foreign currency payments constraints, Arabic language, enforceability of foreign law/forum.

batches.name: Jordan
batches.scope: Cover Consumer Protection Law 7/2017, Electronic Transactions Law 15/2015, Personal Data Protection Law 24/2023 (in force March 2024) and its council/regulations, GST on digital services from non-residents, Arabic language, enforceability.

batches.name: Lebanon
batches.scope: Cover Consumer Protection Law 659/2005 (as amended) incl. distance selling and return rights, Law 81/2018 on Electronic Transactions and Personal Data, banking/payment realities (fresh USD), Arabic/French language, enforceability.

batches.name: Iraq
batches.scope: Cover Consumer Protection Law 1/2010, Electronic Signature and Transactions Law 78/2012, data protection status (draft laws, Kurdistan region), payment realities (Qi Card, ZainCash), Arabic/Kurdish language, enforceability of foreign law/forum.
